data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Havi', meaning 'oblation' or 'offering'. The suffix 'sa' indicates the giver or the one who offers. In Hindu mythology, Havi is the name of a goddess who represents the divine offering or the giver of offerings. The name Havisa carries the meaning “Goddess Havi's giver” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Havisa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess havi's giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the act of giving and selfless devotion.
